subject.name: Mathematics
subject.description: GCE Ordinary Level Mathematics — full syllabus in progressive lessons.
subject.description_fr: Programme complet de mathématiques GCE OL en leçons progressives.

lessons.title: Types of Numbers and Prime Factors
lessons.title_fr: Types de nombres et facteurs premiers
lessons.objective_en: Identify natural numbers, integers, primes, multiples and factors; decompose a number into prime factors; find HCF and LCM.

lessons.title: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages
lessons.objective_en: Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages; compute with fractions; apply percentage increase and decrease in real situations.

lessons.title: Ratio and Proportion
lessons.objective_en: Simplify ratios, share quantities in a given ratio, solve direct and inverse proportion problems.

lessons.title: Estimation and Rounding Practice
lessons.objective_en: Round to given significant figures and decimal places; estimate results; recognise upper and lower bounds.

chapters.title: Powers, Roots and Standard Form
chapters.description: Indices, scientific notation and square roots.

lessons.title: Laws of Indices
lessons.objective_en: Apply the laws of exponents for multiplication, division, powers of powers, zero and negative indices.

lessons.title: Standard Form (Scientific Notation)
lessons.objective_en: Convert very large and small numbers to and from standard form; compute with them.

lessons.title: Squares, Cubes and Roots
lessons.objective_en: Find squares, cubes and their roots, estimate square roots between integers.

chapters.title: Algebra I — Expressions and Linear Equations
chapters.title_fr: Algèbre I — expressions et équations du premier degré
chapters.description: From arithmetic patterns to algebraic reasoning.

lessons.title: Simplifying and Expanding Expressions
lessons.objective_en: Collect like terms, expand single and double brackets, factorise simple expressions.

lessons.title: Solving Linear Equations
lessons.objective_en: Solve one-step and multi-step linear equations, equations with brackets and unknowns on both sides.

lessons.title: Linear Inequalities and Number Lines
lessons.objective_en: Solve linear inequalities and represent the solution set on a number line.

chapters.title: Algebra II — Quadratics and Simultaneous Equations
chapters.title_fr: Algèbre II — second degré et systèmes

lessons.title: Factorising Quadratic Expressions
lessons.objective_en: Factorise quadratics with a = 1 and a > 1; recognise the difference of two squares.

lessons.title: Solving Quadratic Equations
lessons.objective_en: Solve by factorisation, completing the square and the quadratic formula.

lessons.title: Simultaneous Equations
lessons.objective_en: Solve pairs of linear simultaneous equations by substitution and elimination.

lessons.title: Angles at Points and on Lines
lessons.objective_en: Use angle facts: points, straight lines, parallel lines, corresponding and alternate angles.

lessons.title: Triangles and Quadrilaterals
lessons.objective_en: Apply angle sums in triangles and quadrilaterals; classify special quadrilaterals.

lessons.title: Polygons — Interior and Exterior Angles
lessons.objective_en: Calculate interior and exterior angle sums of regular polygons.

lessons.title: Perimeter and Area of 2D Shapes
lessons.objective_en: Compute perimeters and areas of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms, trapezia and composite shapes.

lessons.title: Circles — Circumference and Area
lessons.objective_en: Use C = 2πr and A = πr²; sectors and arcs introduction.

lessons.title: Surface Area and Volume of Solids
lessons.objective_en: Prisms, cylinders, cones, spheres: calculate surface area and volume.

lessons.title: Pythagoras' Theorem
lessons.objective_en: Apply Pythagoras to find missing sides; converse to check right angles.

lessons.title: SOH CAH TOA — Sine, Cosine and Tangent
lessons.objective_en: Find missing sides and angles in right triangles using trigonometric ratios.

lessons.title: Mean, Median, Mode and Range
lessons.objective_en: Compute averages from lists and frequency tables; interpret which average fits best.

lessons.title: Charts and Graphs for Data
lessons.objective_en: Build and read bar charts, pie charts, pictograms and histograms.

lessons.title: Introduction to Probability
lessons.objective_en: Probability scale, mutually exclusive events, combined probabilities with tables.
